name: Province - Default (seed v1)
description: An optional level between town and kingdom: it groups towns of one kingdom. A town in a province must be in the province's kingdom (territory V1, #326).

steps.description: Name the province and pick its kingdom. Towns join it on the town form.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Unique within its kingdom, at most 100 characters.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional, a line or two for admins.

fields.label: Kingdom
fields.description: The kingdom the province is part of. It can only move to another kingdom while it has no towns.
